justification: Inspected ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/ui/compilationchooser/CompilationChooser.java; this package contains only that one class. It is used by only two classes in the repo (ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/ui/compilechain/CompileChainStage.java and ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/ui/triview/TriView.java). Its internal dependencies are mainly org.adoptopenjdk.jitwatch.model and org.adoptopenjdk.jitwatch.ui.main, which are much more central in the codebase (403 and 35 direct imports respectively), so the package does not show a dependency on less stable packages than itself.
